Sky Sports and TNT Sports on IPTV: What You Get

Sport is the reason the great majority of UK households start looking at IPTV. A Sky package with the sports channels attached has become one of the larger recurring bills in the house, and it is charged whether you watch four matches a month or forty.

This page sets out which sports channels an IPTV UK subscription actually carries, what each one covers across the season, and how the total compares with the same coverage bought conventionally.

10 min read•Updated 14 August 2026
Full sports channel listPremier League coverage explainedCost against a Sky package

UK sport is split across a small number of broadcasters, and which one shows a given fixture is decided by rights deals rather than anything you control. Any service worth paying for has to carry both of the big sports packages, because between them they hold nearly all the domestic football.

The Sky Sports Channels

The full Sky Sports line-up is carried, including the channels most packages treat as premium add-ons. Main Event, Premier League and F1 are available in 4K where Sky provides a 4K feed.

The TNT Sports Channels

TNT Sports holds the rights Sky does not, which makes it non-negotiable rather than optional. Champions League and Europa League football, Premiership rugby, and a large share of the boxing calendar all sit here.

ChannelWhat it carriesQuality
TNT Sports 1Champions League, Europa League, Premier League fixtures, Premiership rugby4K
TNT Sports 2Additional European football, rugby, UFC and MotoGP4K
TNT Sports 3Overflow coverage when several matches clashHD
TNT Sports 4Further simultaneous fixtures and secondary eventsHD
TNT Sports UltimateThe 4K feed for marquee fixtures4K

Beyond the two main packages, the line-up carries Premier Sports, LaLiga TV, Eurosport 1 and 2, Racing TV, MUTV, LFC TV, DAZN and Viaplay Sports. The full list is on the IPTV UK channel list, where you can search for a specific channel before you commit to anything.

Premier League Coverage, Honestly Described

This is where providers make claims that do not survive contact with the season, so it is worth being precise.

Across a Premier League season, 267 of the 380 fixtures are broadcast live in the UK. Sky Sports carries the largest share, TNT Sports takes a smaller block, and Amazon has held a set of midweek fixtures. Because the line-up here carries both Sky and TNT, the great majority of televised matches are available.

The claim to be sceptical about

Any provider advertising "every Premier League match" is describing something that does not exist in the UK. Saturday 3pm kick-offs are not broadcast domestically at all under the blackout rule — no legitimate service can show you a UK feed of a match that has no UK feed.

The 3pm fixtures are broadcast in other countries, and the international sports channels in the line-up carry some of those feeds. That is how most subscribers watch blacked-out matches, and it is a materially different thing from a UK broadcast — worth understanding before you buy rather than after.

Beyond Football

Cricket

England home Tests, ODIs and T20s on Sky Sports Cricket, plus The Hundred, county cricket and overseas tours. Winter Ashes tours run through the night and are exactly the kind of thing a subscription earns its keep on.

Formula 1

4K

Sky Sports F1 carries every practice session, qualifying and race of the season, plus F2, F3 and the archive coverage between race weekends.

Rugby

Premiership rugby on TNT Sports, Six Nations coverage across the free-to-air channels also in the line-up, and rugby league on Sky Sports Action.

Boxing and PPV

No extra charge

Sky Sports Box Office events are included rather than billed separately, which is where the cost difference against a conventional package becomes most obvious — a single PPV night can cost more than a month of most IPTV plans.

Golf

The Masters, The Open, the Ryder Cup and week-to-week PGA and DP World Tour coverage on Sky Sports Golf.

Racing

Sky Sports Racing and Racing TV between them cover UK and Irish meetings through the week, including the Cheltenham and Aintree festivals.

Getting the Best Picture on Match Day

Live sport is the least forgiving thing you can stream. Fast motion, high bitrate, and everyone in the country watching the same fixture at the same time.

  • ✓Run an Ethernet cable to the television — the single biggest improvement
  • ✓Allow around 25 Mbps for a 4K feed, 10 Mbps for HD
  • ✓Open the channel a few minutes before kick-off so the buffer fills
  • ✓Pause large downloads elsewhere in the house before the match
  • ✓Build a favourites list of sports channels so you are not scrolling at kick-off
  • ✓Use the 5 GHz band if a cable genuinely is not possible

If a match stutters, the buffering guide works through the causes in order, and service status shows whether anything is wrong at our end.

Test it on a match night, not a quiet afternoon

A free 24-hour trial tells you nothing useful at 11am on a Tuesday. Time it for a Saturday afternoon or a midweek European night, when the servers and your own broadband are both under real load.

Frequently Asked Questions

Does IPTV UK include Sky Sports?+

Yes — the complete Sky Sports line-up, including Main Event, Premier League, Football, Cricket, F1, Golf, Action, Arena, Sky Sports News, Racing, Mix and Sky Sports+. Main Event, Premier League and F1 are carried in 4K where Sky provides a 4K feed.

Can I watch every Premier League match?+

You can watch the great majority of televised fixtures, because the line-up carries both Sky Sports and TNT Sports. But 267 of the 380 matches are broadcast live in the UK, and Saturday 3pm kick-offs are not shown domestically at all under the blackout rule. Any provider promising every match is describing something that does not exist in the UK.

Is TNT Sports included?+

Yes, TNT Sports 1 to 4 plus TNT Sports Ultimate. That matters because TNT holds Champions League and Europa League football and Premiership rugby, none of which appear on Sky — a service carrying only one of the two packages leaves real gaps.

Do I pay extra for pay-per-view boxing?+

No. Sky Sports Box Office events are included on every plan rather than billed per event, which is where the difference against a conventional package is most visible — a single PPV night can cost more than a month of most plans here.

Can I watch sport in 4K?+

Yes, on the channels where the broadcaster provides a 4K feed — Sky Sports Main Event, Premier League and F1, and TNT Sports 1, 2 and Ultimate. You will want roughly 25 Mbps of steady broadband and a 4K television for it to be worth having.

What about cricket and Formula 1?+

Sky Sports Cricket carries England home Tests, ODIs and T20s along with The Hundred, county cricket and overseas tours. Sky Sports F1 carries every practice, qualifying session and race of the season plus F2 and F3.

Will it buffer during a big match?+

Big fixtures put every service under load, which is exactly why the trial exists. Run it on a Saturday afternoon or a midweek European night rather than a quiet morning. A wired connection to the television is the single most effective thing you can do at your end.

How does the cost compare with Sky Sports through Sky?+

Conventionally you need a base package, the Sky Sports add-on, a separate TNT subscription, often a 4K upgrade, and pay-per-view nights billed individually — usually on an 18 or 24-month contract. Plans here start at £14.99 with all of that included and no auto-renewal. The pricing page sets out the four options.

Next step

Watch a full match before you pay anything

Take the free 24-hour trial on a match day, load the sports channels you actually care about, and watch a full fixture end to end on your own broadband.

Do not judge it by opening ten channels for thirty seconds each. A complete match during a busy evening is the only test that tells you what a season will feel like. Choose a plan once it has held up under that.
